name: Transaction
oneLine: The basic unit of communication: one person's stimulus plus the other's response.
whatYouDid: Priya's question to Arjun about the hotfix was only a stimulus; you had to wait for his reply before there was an actual transaction to diagnose.
confusion: People often count a single line - a question, a greeting, a complaint - as a transaction on its own; the tell is that nothing has actually been exchanged yet until someone replies.

fromBook.quote: the opening communication is called the stimulus. The reply is called the response.

expand.definition: A transaction is a transactional stimulus plus a transactional response - Berne called it "the basic unit of social discourse." One line, however loaded, is at most half of one.
expand.otherFraming: TA Today notes that a real conversation is a chain of transactions, where each response becomes the stimulus for the next - so a transaction is also the smallest repeating unit you can cut a conversation into.
expand.tryThisToday: Next time you catch yourself reacting hard to just one line someone said, notice that you're already building the response half of a transaction neither of you has finished yet.
